facts.fact: AfricInvest (home country not stated; invests via the Cathay AfricInvest Innovation Fund) put an estimated US$10,000,000 into Nigerian payments platform PalmPay in its US$100m Series A, closed August 2021, alongside Chuangshi Capital, Yunshi Equity Investment Management, Trust Capital and Chengyu Capital; the ticket is estimated, not disclosed.
